criteria.justification: The diff uses only `addReview(productId: ID!, rating: Int!, body: String)` with Review fields id, rating, body, createdAt, product, author — none of the flagged fabrications (reviewText, title, rating enum, updateReview/deleteReview, bogus reviews argument) appear.
The mutation is invoked exactly as `addReview(productId: $productId, rating: $rating, body: $body)`.
Declares `$productId: ID!` and passes it as the productId argument.
Declares `$rating: Int!` and types the TS parameter as `rating: number`.
`$body: String` (nullable) with an optional TS parameter `body?: string` sent as `body ?? null`.
The selection set is `id rating body createdAt product { id } author { displayName }`, all top-level fields listed as existing on Review.
The request is routed through the authenticated path with `{ authenticated: true }` and documented as "on behalf of the signed-in customer".
